## In Memory of Plants

W̱SÁNEĆ peoples have cared for these lands and waters since time immemorial.

The memory preserved here is much more limited: collected specimens, names written down on lists, and observations shared through iNaturalist, reaching back to `r period$first`.

Each record is a moment when someone stopped to take note of a plant.

Some plants are reported often. Some have appeared only in more recent years, while [others have quietly disappeared from the record.](#pane:LostPlants){.saanich-traces-next}
